title: Which guidance applies to Plans and Pricing?

question.author: member_028
question.body: There seem to be different descriptions of plans and pricing. What is the maintained CloudBox guidance?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: CloudBox offers four plans. Free: 10 GB for individuals. Plus: 2 TB for $9.99 per month. Business: 10 TB shared across the organization with team folders, roles, and SSO, at $14.99 per user per month. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
